name: packs.get
title: Read a statutory value
description: Reads the Singapore statutory values in force on a date from the organisation's active statutory pack: GST rates, codes and limits, CPF, SDL and corporate income tax rates, and filing deadlines. Each value is a fact with the pack's key and version and its official source. Quote statutory values only from this tool, never from memory.

on.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD; left out, the organisation's today.

name.description: Only this value, such as a GST code or a limit's name; all the pack's when left out.
